phone_intro: Steer downloads and streaming on this PC from another device. Nothing has to be installed there — the device only opens a page this program serves.
phone_enable_hint: While this is off, no other device can reach this PC.
phone_reach_network: Every device on my network (needed to control it from elsewhere)
phone_status_failed: Could not listen on this port - is it already in use?
phone_status_waiting: Listening. Waiting for a device to connect...
phone_status_contact: A device reached this PC (last contact {when}).
phone_token_new_warning:
A new token disconnects every device that is paired right now. They have to connect again.

Generate a new token?
phone_code_hint: Point a device's camera at the code, or copy the address to any other device.
phone_code_off: Switch it on to get a code.
phone_code_missing: The optional 'qrcode' package is missing - use the address below.
phone_on_the_phone: Using the remote page on a device
phone_step_scan: 1. Scan the code, or open the address on any device. The token is remembered, so this is only needed once.
phone_step_install: 2. Add it to the home screen - Android (Chrome): menu, Add to home screen. iPhone (Safari): share button, Add to Home Screen.
phone_step_share: 3. Then share instead of copy: in the YouTube app tap Share and pick Clipster. On the iPhone use a Shortcut (see the README).
android_section_intro: Puts YouTube Clipster onto your phone so it runs there on its own — downloads, streaming and settings on the device. This is not remote control of this PC.
android_intro: One step at a time — use Back and Continue at the bottom of the window.
android_wizard_prepare_body: Complete the four points below on the PC and phone. When adb and the phone are ready, continue to the terms.
android_wizard_adb_body: This computer needs adb to talk to your phone over USB. Install it here if it is missing.
android_wizard_developer_body: On the phone: Settings → About phone → tap “Build number” seven times, then Settings → System → Developer options → turn on USB debugging.
android_wizard_connect_body: Plug the phone in with a data cable. When the phone asks whether to allow USB debugging, tap “Allow”. The status below updates automatically while you wait.
android_wizard_usb_install_body:
On Xiaomi/HyperOS phones, also turn on in Developer options:
• “Install via USB”
• “USB debugging (Security settings)” if shown
• Confirm any Mi Account prompt
android_wizard_usb_install_note: Not a Xiaomi phone? You can still continue — these settings are harmless if absent.
android_wizard_terms_body: Clipster on the phone runs under these terms:
android_wizard_termux_body: Clipster needs the official Termux from GitHub (not the Play Store). Press the button below to download and install it on the phone.
android_wizard_termux_warning:
If the phone says the app is for an older Android version or blocks the install:
1. Tap the small arrow or ⋮ / ▼ menu on the warning
2. Then tap “Install anyway”

“Install via USB” from point 4 above should already be on. On Android 14+ an older-version warning for Termux is normal.
android_wizard_termux_usb_prompt: USB install was blocked. Check point 4 (“Install via USB”) on the phone, then retry — or install termux-github.apk from Downloads yourself.
android_wizard_setup_body: This computer packs Clipster, sends it to the phone, and starts the setup command in Termux.
android_wizard_done_body: When Android asks for storage access, tap Allow (otherwise: Permission denied on Downloads). Watch Termux until setup finishes. The program installs the Clipster app icon in your app list — tap Clipster to start. On Xiaomi: “Install via USB” must be on (otherwise tap clipster-launcher.apk in Downloads). Exempt Clipster from battery optimisation if offered.
android_adb_missing: adb is not installed — without it no phone can be reached.
android_adb_windows: Install the Android SDK platform tools and put adb on the PATH.
android_adb_manual: Install the Android platform tools for your system.
android_adb_declined: Not installed — adb is still missing.
android_device_none: No phone found. Plug it in with a cable that carries data.
android_device_unauthorised: The phone is asking whether to allow USB debugging — tap “Allow” on its screen.
android_device_offline: The phone answers but is not ready. Unplug it and plug it in again.
android_finish_hint: Fallback only — Install above already does this. If you need to run it by hand, use the short line below.
android_terms_ask: Accept these terms of use for Clipster on the phone?
android_terms_declined: Terms not accepted — installation was not started.
android_run_started: Setup is running in Termux on the phone. When Android asks for storage access, tap Allow. Watch Termux until it finishes. The Clipster app icon is being installed — tap Clipster in your app list to start.
android_launcher_grant_hint: Grant "Run commands in Termux" for Clipster if Android asks.
android_run_failed: The setup command could not be started. In Termux run: bash ~/clipster-phone-setup.sh — do not use /sdcard/… if you see Permission denied.
android_run_failed_termux_missing: Termux could not be started. Install it from GitHub or F-Droid (not the Play Store), then try again.
android_run_failed_termux_not_open: Termux did not come to the front, so nothing was typed — a command must never land in another app. Open Termux on the phone and press Install again.
android_run_failed_typing_failed: The phone did not accept the keystrokes. Copy the short line below and run it in Termux by hand.
android_run_failed_untypeable: This command cannot be typed safely. Copy it and run it in Termux by hand.
android_copied: Copied. Paste it into Termux on the phone.
android_termux_opened: Termux was brought to the front on the phone.
android_termux_failed: Termux could not be started — open it by hand.
android_termux_play_found: Play Store Termux detected — it cannot install packages correctly.
android_termux_play_kept: Kept Play Store Termux — installation stopped. Replace it from GitHub or F-Droid, then try again.
android_termux_missing: Termux is not installed on the phone.
android_termux_manual_apk: USB install blocked — APK copied to Downloads on the phone.
android_termux_usb_blocked: The phone blocked USB app installs (common on Xiaomi/HyperOS).
android_termux_usb_aborted: Termux install stopped — enable Install via USB, then try again.
android_termux_waiting_manual: Waiting for Termux on the phone… Open Downloads, tap termux-github.apk, Install.
android_termux_wait_timeout: Termux did not appear in time. Install termux-github.apk from Downloads, then press Install again.
discover_status_idle: Click Find similar songs to start your streaming queue.
discover_empty: Please pick something you like on YouTube first. Similar titles will then be found from that song.
discover_search_hint: Please pick something you like on YouTube first. Similar titles will then be found from that song.
discover_no_seeds: No seed songs found. Download tracks with Clipster, like songs in Streaming, or add media files to your Downloads / Music folders.
discover_blocked: YouTube blocked Streaming (sign-in / bot check). In Settings → YouTube cookies, acknowledge the risk and set a browser or cookies.txt (optional, own account), then try again.

discover_blocked_partial: YouTube started blocking further requests; showing partial results.
discover_suffix_relaxed: No titles contained “{suffix}”, so matching was relaxed.
discover_filtered_empty: {count} YouTube hits found, but none contained “{suffix}”. Uncheck the ending filter or change the ending.
discover_extend_empty: No additional related songs found right now.
discover_playback_failed: The stream could not be started.
discover_playback_skip: Track not playable — skipping to the next.
discover_playback_bot: The stream could not start — YouTube asked for sign-in / bot check. In Settings → YouTube cookies, acknowledge the risk and set a browser or cookies.txt (optional, own account).
discover_playback_bot_with_cookies: The stream could not start — cookies were sent but YouTube still blocked (bot check). Refresh login or export fresh cookies under Settings → YouTube cookies.
discover_require_suffix: Only show titles that contain the ending
settings_discover_require_suffix: Only keep Streaming results with that ending in the title
settings_cookies_hint: Optional, at your own risk — own YouTube account only. May conflict with YouTube’s terms; does not authorize infringement. If YouTube asks you to sign in / confirm you are not a bot: tick the risk box below, choose a logged-in browser or cookies.txt, then Save. Cookie contents are never stored in the log.
settings_cookies_risk_ack: I understand that using cookies is at my own risk and may violate third-party terms.
history_empty: No downloads yet. Copy a YouTube link and the download starts by itself.
history_delete_failed: The file could not be deleted: {details}
column_sort_tip: Click to sort by this column
column_resize_tip: Drag to change the column width
history_clear_confirm: Remove all entries from the list? The downloaded files are kept.
tray_tooltip: YouTube Clipster - waiting for a link
tray_minimized: YouTube Clipster keeps running in the system tray. Use the tray icon to quit it.
tray_minimized_click: YouTube Clipster keeps running in the system tray. Click the tray icon to open this window again.
link_received: YouTube link received, preparing the process...
nav_clip_hint: Empty = whole video. Times like 1:23 or 0:45 - 2:10.
clip_error_time: That is not a time - please write it like 1:23.
clip_error_order: The end has to come after the start.
clip_error_range: The start lies behind the end of the video.
nav_already: This video has already been downloaded.
error_bot_detected: YouTube blocked this request (sign-in / bot check). In Settings → YouTube cookies, acknowledge the risk and set a browser or cookies.txt (optional, own account), then try again.
error_bot_with_cookies: YouTube still blocked this request (bot check) even though cookies were sent. Refresh your YouTube login or export fresh cookies under Settings → YouTube cookies, then try again.
error_unavailable: This video is not available (private, deleted or region locked).
error_forbidden:
YouTube refused to hand out this stream (HTTP 403), even after retrying with other formats and players.

The track can usually still be played in the Streaming tab. Try again later, or set a browser or cookies.txt under Settings → YouTube cookies.
error_metadata:

settings_restart_note: Language, tray icon and startup visibility apply the next time the program starts.
about_text: Downloads YouTube videos or audio automatically as soon as a YouTube link is copied to the clipboard. One Python code base for Linux, Windows and macOS.
about_license: GPLv3 - the author's name (Joachim Ruf, Loresoft.de) must be credited upon publication and modification.
about_terms_note: On first launch you must accept the terms of use. Streaming requires an additional confirmation the first time you use it.
